description: Lists all Google Tag Manager accounts the authorized user can access. Returns { account: [{ accountId, name, path, fingerprint }], nextPageToken }. All ids are strings. This is the entry point: every other tool needs an accountId (or a path) from here.

page_token.description: Pagination token from a previous response's nextPageToken. Omit for the first page.

name: list_accounts
title: List GTM accounts
